2511-2577-7084-8345.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2511-2577-7084-8345.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

4499-6097-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

4050-5465-8077-8107.description:
Cast Raffine's Guidance from your graveyard by paying {W} due to Doc Aurlock.
Sigil of the Empty Throne triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve Raffine's Guidance, attaching it to another creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Raffine's Guidance attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7157.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

215-955-3291.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-955-3291.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

478-1399-6984-7775.notablePrerequisites:
Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it.
You control at least six creatures.
478-1399-6984-7775.description:
Activate Evendo, Waking Haven by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Evendo, Waking Haven and Wirewood Lodge.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Formidable Speaker.
Activate Formidable Speaker by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Candelabra of Tawnos.
Repeat.

3240-6462-6798-7422.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3430-4499-6763-6973.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Mutable Explorer.
When Mutable Explorer enters, it triggers, creating an untapped Mutavault land token due to Horizon Explorer.
Activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Repeat.

280-1558-3875-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1558-3875-4231-4365.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2713-3094-4659-7295-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2713-3094-4659-7295-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2292-3269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2292-3269.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2292-3269.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

225-539-765-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping PuPu UFO as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

280-4826-5449-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-4826-5449-5702.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1879-3259-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
1879-3259-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-5972-5973.easyPrerequisites:
Griffin Guide attached to another creature you control.
You control an additional creature beyond those included above and the one that has Griffin Guide attached.
2292-5972-5973.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with Griffin Guide attached.
When the creature dies, Cass and Griffin Guide trigger.
Resolve the Griffin Guide trigger, creating a 2/2 Griffin creature token.
Resolve the Cass trigger, returning Griffin Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

307-2327-3821.notablePrerequisites:
Moon-Circuit Hacker and Peregrine Drake do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Moon-Circuit Hacker or Peregrine Drake.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
307-2327-3821.description:
Declare Peregrine Drake and Moon-Circuit Hacker as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Moon-Circuit Hacker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake that is tapped and attacking.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Moon-Circuit Hacker's ninjutsu ability by paying {U} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Moon-Circuit Hacker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Peregrine Drake tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2882-3195-3624-4999.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Dromar's Attendant.
2882-3195-3624-4999.description:
Cast Flourishing Fox either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Dromar's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Flourishing Fox by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}.
If you cast Flourishing Fox from your graveyard, Flourishing Fox is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Flourishing Fox's cycling ability.
Repeat.

2218-3661-4763-5147.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching Ronin Warclub to Shield Sphere.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Koll triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

856-1201-1651-4365.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Food tokens, untapping Witch's Oven.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Caludron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

203-565-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}.
203-565-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}.
Cast Anoint with buyback by paying {3}{W}, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
The Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve Anoint, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

2557-3456-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Rapacious Dragon.
Rapacious Dragon enters the battlefield, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

201-2302.description:
Painter's Servant causes all creatures to be black.
Because Light of Day prevents black creatures from attacking or blocking, no creature can attack or block.
